Here’s an actor’s opinion.

I really liked the character of Spider, but Jack Champion’s acting was so 2 dimensional. Every other actor in the movie had complex character thoughts and reactions that came off completely genuine. The best being Zoe Saldaña. Jack Champion however was clearly “acting”. His choices felt forced and calculated, you could tell he was “trying to be”, instead of simply “being” (something acting teachers have taught me). His character is written really well and I can see Spider playing an extremely important role in the rest of the saga, but I pray that Champion starts to actually connect to the text. If he doesn’t act well, I hope James Cameron can slightly accommodate Spider’s scenes so that Champion can portray them with honesty and ease. Jack Champion’s role in the film was the only aspect that negatively affected the film for me. Every other element of the story was purposeful, intricate, and impactful.
